When one robot loves another robot very much, and they’re connected by a wire, they can get together and make a brand new robot! SFW. [ JSK Lab ] What happens when Microducks meet? They start to sing together. Each Microduck syncs with its neighbors over Bluetooth, then they compose a song on the fly, in harmony and in perfect time. There’s no score and no conductor. Two, three, or four ducks are enough for a choir to break out. If Pollen isn’t selling Microducks in four packs for this exact reason, WHAT ARE THEY EVEN DOING!? [ Pollen ] In an internal test, Google DeepMind robotics researchers instructed Gemini 4 Argon to watch a video of a human playing cornhole. Using its video understanding and advanced reasoning capabilities, Gemini 4 built a virtual simulation in MuJoCo and accurately calculated the physics and whole-body control required for Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid to sink seven consecutive shots in the real world. This Video-to-Sim-to-Real pipeline compresses weeks of manual modeling into a few hours, transforming ordinary videos into an infinite training ground for physical AI. [ Google DeepMind ] As of Oct. 11, 2026, NASA’s Perseverance rover has driven 28.10 miles (45.22 kilometers), becoming the new off-world record-holder for total distance driven by any vehicle on the surface of another world. The previous record of 28.06 miles (45.16 kilometers) was held by NASA’s Opportunity rover. Perseverance reached that mark on the 2,006th Martian day, or sol, of its mission, covering in five and a half years a distance that took Opportunity almost 15. [ JPL ] Let’s not argue about whether these are robots or not and just agree that they’re cool. [ OATs ] If one cute little robot can clean up one block, how many blocks can 40 cute little robots clean up? Science has the answers! [ Paper ] Thanks, Keisuke! Before Rosalind Franklin can explore Mars, it has to get off its lander. Engineers are rehearsing that first journey on Earth, using a full-size rover model and Mars-like terrain. The test recreates some of the challenges Rosalind Franklin will face on the Red Planet, from reduced gravity and a 20-degree incline to uneven ground and obstacles beneath its ramps. [ European Space Agency ] From custom part to running robot, the Atlas shop floor is built on precision, rapid assembly, and real-time collaboration. By machining parts in-house and streamlining assembly and repair under one roof, we are driving the manufacturing velocity needed to turn complex designs into walking hardware at scale. [ Boston Dynamics ] What can a quadruped robot do beyond the lab? Deep in China’s Ailao Mountains, DEEP Robotics M20S joined a team of researchers on a biodiversity field expedition—navigating rugged terrain, scouting routes ahead, carrying research equipment, and capturing wildlife in areas that are difficult to access on foot. [ DEEP Robotics ] The Kamino simulation software is a GPU-accelerated physics solver designed for accurate simulation of complex mechanical systems with kinematic loops, such as parallel manipulators, planar and spatial linkages, and multi-limbed robots with coupled joints, without requiring simplified approximations. [ Disney Research ] The original Kawasaki UNIMATE robot as featured in (remember this show?) the MacNeil/Lehrer Report in 1992. [ Kawasaki Robotics ] WildOS enables autonomous robots to perform long-range, open-vocabulary object search in previously unmapped and unstructured outdoor environments by unifying geometric safety with semantic visual reasoning. Through a vision-scored navigation graph and beyond-horizon target localization, the system demonstrates more efficient and robust exploration than conventional geometric or purely vision-based approaches in extensive field experiments. [ ETH Zurich Robotics Systems Lab ] Who needs an AI-generated person when you can have an actual robot that looks exactly like an AI-generated person instead? [ UBTECH Robotics ] The recovery behaviors here are impressive, but the robot is far slower than a human would be, suggesting that the value it generates is primarily in novelty. Which is fine, for now, but novelty wears off, and then what? title: ‘2026 로보월드’서 한양대 ERICA 혁신허브 입주기업 모집 현장 접수
summary: 국내 최대 규모의 로봇산업 전시회인 ‘2026 로보월드’에서 한양대학교 ERICA 혁신허브 입주기업 모집을 위한 현장 접수와 투자설명회가 열린다.경기도와 안산시, 한양대 ERICA 등 관련 기관은 로봇·첨단산업 분야 기업을 대상으로 입주 여건과 기업 지원사업을 소개하고, 안산사이언스밸리지구의 산업·연구 기반을 알릴 예정이다.한양대 ERICA는 오는 11월 4일부터 7일까지 나흘간 경기도 고양시 킨텍스 제1전시장에서 열리는 ‘2026 로보월드’에 마련된 안산사이언스밸리지구(ASV) 홍보 부스에서 혁신허브 입주 신청을 현장 접수한다.이
